description: Fork of exp738 (untied vanilla bs=48 4K, bf16 autocast = 1.3984 @ 35.79M). Single change: compute_dtype bf16 -> fp32; train.py autocast wrap is conditional (no-op when compute_dtype=fp32). Establishes the 4K bs=48 fp32 vanilla baseline for isolating the bf16-compute cost vs exp738 (same shape, same schedule, only compute precision differs). Reference for the apples-to-apples comparison: exp732 (LUT fp32, 1.3912) vs exp737 v2 (LUT bf16, ~1.385); now exp738 (vanilla bf16, 1.3984) vs exp739 (vanilla fp32, this run). Expected wallclock similar to exp738 (~6-10 min on H100, depending on contention).
